full_method_trace_audit.note: Initial launcher override did not disable inline main-return terminate probes. Original lifecycle retained; both snapshots preserved.

source_after_measurement_changes: Removed ineffective method launcher override and corrected lifecycle metadata.
Full-order runner now preserves lifecycle snapshots and chooses final Remote for full method mode.
Overlay manifest describes full original method event instrumentation.
Added reproducible independent positive-control command and unknown-answer scoring tests.
limitations: One deployment per mode in fixed order; no stable ranking or confidence claim.
FlowDist uses full original method events, branch probes and disclosed HTTP/lambda/runtime adaptations.
TraceFusion observes Orders DTO/RPC/stream data and Shipping boundary fields; tracing scopes differ.
Offline query/reconstruction and static preprocessing are excluded and must be measured separately.
Allocation includes background activity; RSS is whole-process resident memory, not per-call retained memory.
Business oracle checks are not information-flow accuracy; field/path predictions require separate evaluation.
Only seven aggregate field-type relations to total in the Orders JVM; not general accuracy.
FlowDist uses original graph/query algorithms with disclosed lambda model and framework exclusions.
TraceFusion uses its independently derived scalar/stream model; predictions do not read expected labels.
Whole-deployment branch coverage includes startup and warmup; not individual request coverage.
Cross-process source instance/path accuracy requires HTTP DTO modeling and separate evaluation.
Local field-type results contain model-support differences and do not isolate core algorithm superiority.
Memory measurements exclude offline analysis; RSS and allocation describe different quantities.
FlowDist original main-return/shutdown lifecycle retained; legacy no-main-terminate metadata was corrected by audit.
next_step: Cross-HTTP DTO fields and request/object-instance paths, concurrent same-value counterexamples, then randomized repeated cost rounds
